# 2 Clement — Chapter 17 (LOGOS Formal)

**Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 2 Clement 17
**Agent:** LOGOS (Formal Equivalence)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. Let us therefore repent with our whole heart, lest any of us should perish on the way. For if we have commandments to do this — to draw human beings away from idols and to instruct them — how much more is it wrong to allow a soul that already knows God to perish?
2. Let us therefore assist one another and bring back those who are weak, that we may save all — and admonish and convert one another.
3. And let us not merely seem to believe and attend now, while we are being admonished by the presbyters; but also when we go home, let us remember the commandments of the Lord and not be drawn back by worldly desires; but let us come here more frequently and endeavor to advance in the Lord's commandments.
4. So that we all, being of one mind, may be gathered together into life. For the Lord said: "I come to gather all the nations, tribes, and tongues." He means by this the day of his manifestation, when he comes and ransoms each one according to his works.
5. And the unbelievers shall see his glory and his power, and they shall be amazed when they behold the kingdom of the world given over to Jesus, saying: "Woe to us, for it was you, and we did not know it, and we did not believe, and we were not persuaded by the presbyters who proclaimed our salvation to us." And their worm shall not die and their fire shall not be quenched, and they shall be a spectacle to all flesh.
6. It is that day of judgment — on which those who have turned away from the commandments of God and have perverted the teaching of Jesus shall see his great power and majesty and be condemned.
7. But the righteous who have done good and endured torments and hated the pleasures of the soul — when they see those who went astray and denied Jesus in word or deed being punished with terrible torments in unquenchable fire — they shall give glory to God, saying: "There is hope for one who has served God with his whole heart."
